project.title: Source Completeness & Traceability Lens
project.subtitle: Standalone prototype roadmap; source omissions revealed, not repaired
project.aim: 100% traceability at source level: reveal original DOCX content that was not captured, partially captured, altered, excluded, unsupported or uncertain. Show omissions directly on authentic source pages. Traceability and disclosure, not conversion repair; never claim 100% capture.

M1.name: P1 — Missing Source Lens
M1.full: WBS 1.1: On real R5 DOCX and converted HTML, display authentic Word page and highlight omitted Notes Table #2; click to inspect exact source occurrence and target evidence. New standalone prototype; no converter edits.
M1.canDo: P1 work release prepared; builder not assigned and no runnable demonstration yet.

M2.name: P2 — Source Census Lens
M2.full: WBS 1.2: Navigate all original source pages; inventory source tables and paragraphs, show evidence-bound capture statuses and unresolved identity/location exceptions. Keep P1 source overlay intact.
M2.canDo: P2 is the connected second card, not yet released.

M3.name: P3 — Visual Blind-Spot Lens
M3.full: WBS 1.3: Independently reveal visible source regions not explained by structural inventory; a removed annotation must trigger visible unknown coverage rather than false 100%. Provisional pending P1/P2 Owner trials.
M3.canDo: P3 outcome planned; scope may be re-sliced from Owner tests.

M4.name: P4 — Source Review Lens
M4.full: WBS 1.4: Select unknown source regions, classify and record evidence, export/import review decisions bound to input hashes; no conversion repair. Provisional.
M4.canDo: P4 outcome planned; reviewer workflow not implemented.

M5.name: P5 — Static Evidence Release
M5.full: WBS 1.5: Preserve accepted prototypes, ship static GitHub Pages plus offline standalone HTML, prove evidence integrity, run negative identity/omission tests and independent check. Provisional.
M5.canDo: P5 publication not authorized; no release candidate.
